title: Erase Selected Fills is a silent no-op — StageArea/Shell never pass selectedFaceFilter to planarEraseShape
description: FIXED. Erase Selected Fills now restricts erasure to the current selection (Flash 8). Root cause: planarEraseShape 'selected' mode needs a selectedFaceFilter predicate but neither StageArea nor Shell.handleEraseOnLayer ever supplied it, so the mode erased nothing. Fix: new pure core helper buildSelectedFaceFilter (packages/core/src/engine/planar/subselection.ts) turns a SubSelection's face keys into a point-in-selected-face predicate; shared authoring-ui helper resolveSelectedFaceFilter (packages/authoring-ui/src/eraserSelection.ts) resolves whole-object vs sub-selection vs skip; wired into StageArea interactive erase (~3230) and Shell.handleEraseOnLayer (~1728). Whole-object selection erases all its fills; partial sub-selection erases only selected faces (strokes never select a fill); nothing selected => no-op. VERIFY: full ordered build exit 0; pnpm --filter @flash/core test = 356 files / 5817 pass, 2 skip (planar-eraser.test.ts 21 pass incl. 2 new buildSelectedFaceFilter cases); pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui test = 116 files / 1305 pass (new eraserSelection.test.ts 7 pass incl. acceptance: 2 fills, 1 selected, sweep both -> only selected erased; nothing selected -> nothing erased). docs/04-toolbox.md updated.
